The '''LL-30''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. A pair of these weapons were also used by the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who modified them to his own personal specifications, dubbing them "Persuaders". [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]] also made use of this weapon.

==Description==
[[File:Bane_fires_at_Skywalker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cad Bane firing his LL-30 at Anakin Skywalker]]
The sound of the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was unique ({{Audio|LL30firing-HC.flac|Listen}}), a mixture between the common sound made by most blasters and a high-pitched scream. The blaster had a slim [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], and a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Scope/Legends|scope]] attachment at the top. It had a high firing rate, similar to that of the [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]] used by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Both had the [[Dallorian alloy/Legends|same alloy]] that prevented overheating of the blaster [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] from excess firing. This allowed the user to fire in a fast but sustained volley.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik's]] [[Weequay blaster pistol/Legends|Weequay blaster pistol]] was incorrectly identified as an LL-30 blaster pistol in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''. In [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes|''Republic Heroes'']], the blaster makes the sound of the WESTAR-34 blaster pistol that Jango Fett used in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
